answer: Two established agents cross-sign each new identity, and a recruit that fails inside 30 days drags the voucher's standing down with it. Whether the work is pearl grading, plume exports, or tide-chart updates, the vouch is the part that costs: a farm needs real standing behind every fake seat, and each voucher can back only a handful before its own record thins. Payout vests over ten epochs, so the seat needs two months of upkeep to collect.
